author: Stuarts
body:
Hello, I was banned under the username SRochard but my current IGN is Stuarts.
The moderator who punished me is Taco334 On April 19th 2014.

I have been banned for hacking-forcefeild during a session of Nebula.
I think that i deserve to be unbanned because I have learned from my mistakes and i think that 1 year of waiting should
pay off for my mistakes.
During this 1 year period, i have earned the Administrator title on several servers: Impactmc Initianovamc (both pixelmon)
this proves that I am now aware of the rules and standards of any server.

It is my biggest regret to have been banned from the avicus network, because this server has so much to offer that will be
hard to find somewhere else.My versions folder is cleared from all hack clients or anything that gives me an advantage over a regular player.

I very well knew that hacking was forbidden, but i supposed I could break the rules since I've seen many more do so without
being banned or in trouble.(I mostly thought that staff wasn't flexible enough).

And yes this is my first ban apeal, ever. I have quit the hacking commuity and I frown upon what i've done.
If any of you could forgive me after a 1 year's time, it would mean the world to me.
I am sincerly sorry for what I've done, and to all the players that had to deal with my unfairness.

I miss Nebula,Nexus and all the other servers that Avicus has to offer.
Please, I beg you, give me another chance...

Sincerely, Stuart
